up: Find all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5725679. Return the molecule's preferred name, ChEMBL ID, and compound key. Join the docs table with compound_records and molecule_dictionary to link the document to its reported compounds. Do not apply any additional filters, unit restrictions, or ranking.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, cr.compound_key FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725679'
